title: SPARTA: Evaluating Reasoning Segmentation Robustness through Black-Box Adversarial Paraphrasing in Text Autoencoder Latent Space
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of multimodal models against adversarial paraphrasing in reasoning segmentation tasks. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical belief systems; its 'Ethical Considerations' section is a standard disclosure rather than a core component of the research.
